nodes.name: Email Trigger (IMAP)
nodes.notes: Polls Gmail inbox every minute. Downloads all attachments as binary. SETUP: replace credential ID with your IMAP credential after creating it in n8n Settings > Credentials.

nodes.name: Check Has CSV
nodes.notes: Only processes emails that have attachments. Emails without attachments go to the false branch (ignored). True branch = has attachments → continue to pipeline.

nodes.name: Analyze CSV
nodes.notes: Sends the CSV attachment to FastAPI /analyze endpoint as multipart form data. The binary property 'attachment_0' is the first email attachment. If the attachment binary has a different name (check IMAP trigger output), update 'inputDataFieldName' accordingly.

nodes.name: Download Report
nodes.notes: Downloads the generated .md report as a binary file. run_id comes from the Analyze CSV response. Response Format must be 'File' — check Options > Response > Response Format.

nodes.name: Reply With Report

parameters.subject: =Re: {{ $('Email Trigger (IMAP)').item.json.subject }} — Analysis Complete

nodes.notes: Replies to the original sender with the .md report attached. toEmail pulls the sender address from the IMAP trigger. SETUP: replace credential ID with your SMTP credential.

_notes.purpose: Gmail listener — email arrives with CSV → pipeline runs → report emailed back to sender
how_to_test: 1. Enable IMAP in Gmail settings (Settings > Forwarding and POP/IMAP > Enable IMAP)
2. Create IMAP credential in n8n (imap.gmail.com, port 993, SSL on, App Password)
4. Replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_IMAP_CREDENTIAL_ID with your actual IMAP credential ID
5. Replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_SMTP_CREDENTIAL_ID with your actual SMTP credential ID
6. Make sure uvicorn is running: uvicorn automation.scripts.api:app --reload --port 8000
7. Click 'Test Workflow' in n8n — it will wait for an email
8. Send an email to mu181842@gmail.com with a CSV file attached
9. Within 1 minute, n8n should pick it up and email the report back to you

troubleshooting.attachment_binary_name: If Analyze CSV fails, click the IMAP trigger output and check what binary property names appear. Update inputDataFieldName in Analyze CSV node to match.
troubleshooting.imap_connection: If IMAP credential fails, make sure IMAP is enabled in Gmail AND you're using App Password not your real password.
troubleshooting.pipeline_fails: Check uvicorn terminal for errors. The /analyze endpoint logs each run.
